name: S.S. Alan Bean
about: S.S. Alan Bean (2019-071A), a crewed vehicle (Cygnus), launched 2019 Nov  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2019 Nov  3), held fixed
